tool_schemas.name: sequentialthinking
tool_schemas.description: Appends a single thought to an ongoing sequential chain, optionally marking it as a revision of an earlier thought or as a branch off a prior thought, and returns the updated sequence state including whether additional thoughts are expected (based on totalThoughts/nextThoughtNeeded/needsMoreThoughts). This endpoint is not paged; each call records one thought at thoughtNumber and updates the session’s in-memory ordering/branch metadata keyed by branchId when provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, additionalProperties are present, or isRevision is true without revisesThought (or branchFromThought is set without branchId); raises CONFLICT if thoughtNumber duplicates an existing thought in the same branch without isRevision or if revisesThought/branchFromThought references a non-existent thought number.

nextThoughtNeeded.description: Whether the next thought is needed

isRevision.description: Whether this is a revision of a previous thought

tool_schemas.name: mentalmodel
tool_schemas.description: Records a completed mental-model run for the provided problem, returning the stored artifact containing modelName, steps, reasoning, and conclusion. This endpoint is not paged and does not iterate automatically; each request represents one full model application. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if modelName is not one of the supported enums, required fields are missing, or extra fields are provided; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the workspace/session has reached its artifact limit.

tool_schemas.name: debuggingapproach
tool_schemas.description: Records a completed debugging approach run for the given issue and returns the stored artifact with approachName, steps, findings, and resolution. This endpoint is not paged; one request corresponds to one debugging write-up. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if approachName is not one of the supported enums, required fields are missing, or additional properties are present; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when artifact storage limits are exceeded.

issue.description: Description of the issue being debugged

tool_schemas.name: collaborativereasoning
tool_schemas.description: Captures one iteration of a persona-based collaborative discussion for a topic and sessionId, returning the stored discussion state including personas, contributions, stage, activePersonaId, and iteration. This endpoint is not paged; provide the full current personas and contributions arrays for the iteration you are recording. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, enums/constraints fail (e.g., confidence not in [0,1]), or extra fields are provided; raises NOT_FOUND if activePersonaId or any contributions.personaId does not match a persona in personas; raises CONFLICT if iteration is not the next expected iteration for the given sessionId.

tool_schemas.name: decisionframework
tool_schemas.description: Records one step/iteration of a structured decision workflow for decisionId, returning the stored decision artifact including decisionStatement, options, analysisType, stage, and iteration. This endpoint is not paged; each request represents the decision state at a single iteration. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, options items omit name/description, or extra fields are present; raises CONFLICT if iteration is not the next expected value for the same decisionId or if nextStageNeeded is false while the stage is advanced again.

tool_schemas.name: metacognitivemonitoring
tool_schemas.description: Stores a metacognitive assessment checkpoint for a task, returning the saved monitoring artifact with stage, overallConfidence, uncertaintyAreas, recommendedApproach, monitoringId, and iteration. This endpoint is not paged; each call records one assessment snapshot. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, types are invalid, or additional properties are provided; raises CONFLICT if iteration is not the next expected value for the given monitoringId.

tool_schemas.name: socraticmethod
tool_schemas.description: Records one Socratic-method iteration for a claim within a sessionId, returning the stored inquiry artifact including premises, question, stage, argumentType, conclusion, confidence, and iteration. This endpoint is not paged; each request represents a single questioning step and its current conclusion. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, stage/argumentType is outside the supported enums, confidence is outside [0,1], or extra fields are present; raises CONFLICT if iteration is not the next expected value for the same sessionId or if nextArgumentNeeded is false but additional iterations are submitted.

claim.description: The main claim or topic being explored

tool_schemas.name: creativethinking
tool_schemas.description: Stores one creative-thinking iteration for a prompt in a sessionId, returning the saved artifact with ideas, techniques, connections, insights, and iteration. This endpoint is not paged; each request records a single round of ideation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing or extra fields are provided; raises CONFLICT if iteration is not the next expected value for the same sessionId or if nextIdeaNeeded is false but further iterations are submitted.

tool_schemas.name: systemsthinking
tool_schemas.description: Analyze complex systems and their interactions

tool_schemas.name: scientificmethod
tool_schemas.description: Apply scientific method for systematic inquiry

tool_schemas.name: structuredargumentation
tool_schemas.description: Constructs and analyzes a structured argument from the provided claim, premises, conclusion, and argumentType, returning an evaluation that reflects the supplied confidence and whether nextArgumentNeeded indicates further argument steps are expected. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any required field is missing, premises is not an array of strings, confidence is not a number, or unknown fields are provided. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the current session, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: visualreasoning
tool_schemas.description: Applies the requested operation to the specified diagramId/diagramType at the given iteration and returns the updated visual-reasoning result along with whether nextOperationNeeded indicates follow-up operations are expected. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, iteration is not a number, or unknown fields are provided. Raises NOT_FOUND if diagramId does not exist in the current session, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the session, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: session_info
tool_schemas.description: Returns metadata about a Clear Thought session, including statistics and recent activity, resolving the target session by sessionId (preferred) or clientSessionKey when sessionId is not provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sessionId is present but does not match the required ct_sess_… ULID pattern, or if unknown fields are provided. Raises NOT_FOUND if the referenced session cannot be located, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to view it, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

sessionId.description: Clear Thought session id (ct_sess_... ULID) to fetch info for

clientSessionKey.description: Client-provided session key to identify the session when sessionId is not available

tool_schemas.name: session_export
tool_schemas.description: Exports the current session’s complete state in the requested format (json for full state, summary for a condensed view) and returns the export payload. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if format is provided but is not one of the supported values or if unknown fields are provided. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the session and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: session_import
tool_schemas.description: Imports a previously exported session from sessionData and returns the resulting session state, either replacing existing session data or merging when merge is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sessionData is missing, is not a string, or cannot be parsed as a valid exported session, or if unknown fields are provided. Raises CONFLICT when merge is false and importing would overwrite an existing non-empty session, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot modify the session, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

sessionData.description: JSON string of exported session data

merge.description: Whether to merge with existing session data (default: false)

tool_schemas.name: listsessions
tool_schemas.description: Lists sessions visible to the caller, optionally filtered by lifecycle status and title/clientSessionKey, and returns a paginated result ordered by lastActivityAt desc. Refuses invalid filters or page parameters and may return QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read quota is exhausted.

apiKey.description: Caller credential used to authenticate this request.

clientSessionKey.description: Filter by an exact client-provided session key.

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: getsession
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single session by id and returns the session row (including cached aggregates such as totals and lastActivityAt). Refuses if the session does not exist or is not accessible to the caller.

apiKey.description: Caller credential used to authenticate this request.

sessionId.description: Internal id of the session to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: createsession
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new session with an initial title and optional clientSessionKey and returns the created session. Refuses duplicate clientSessionKey for the same caller or invalid fields.

apiKey.description: Caller credential used to authenticate this request.

clientSessionKey.description: Client-provided stable key used for idempotency and later merges/imports.

tool_schemas.name: updatesession
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a session and/or performs lifecycle transitions by setting status. Returns the updated session. Refuses invalid transitions (active↔archived allowed; deleted is terminal) and refuses updates to deleted sessions.

apiKey.description: Caller credential used to authenticate this request.

sessionId.description: Internal id of the session to update.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the session. Must follow allowed transitions.

tool_schemas.name: sessionexport
tool_schemas.description: Exports a consistent snapshot of a session and its related entities in a single transactional read. format='json' returns the full session row plus all non-deleted thoughts, artifacts (including payload), collaborationSessions, collaborationEntities, and scientificInquiries. format='summary' omits payload blobs and returns counts plus recent previews. Refuses if the session is not accessible.

apiKey.description: Caller credential used to authenticate this request.

sessionId.description: Internal id of the session to export.

tool_schemas.name: sessionimport
tool_schemas.description: Imports a previously exported session snapshot. If merge=false, creates a new session and imports all child entities with new internal ids while preserving external_* ids and payloads. If merge=true, upserts the target session by clientSessionKey (preferred) or import header mapping, and upserts children by natural keys (thoughts by branchId+thoughtNumber, artifacts by toolName+externalObjectId, collaborationSessions by externalSessionId, scientificInquiries by externalInquiryId). Returns the resulting session id and import summary. Refuses malformed JSON or invalid lifecycle/state fields.

apiKey.description: Caller credential used to authenticate this request.

merge.description: Whether to merge into an existing session (upsert) instead of creating a new one.

id.description: Exported internal id (used only for mapping).

client_session_key.description: Client-provided stable key if present in the export.

metadata.name: Clear Thought
